segments.comment: Wizard-mode level teleport (^V, ? for the level menu, first page's bigrm entry) to the Big Room, which wizard mode always places. The bigrm-N variant is rnd(13); every variant runs region(selection, "lit"/"unlit") through lspo_region and sel_set_lit, and most run des.terrain with a selection, des.replace_terrain with fromterrain or a selection, des.teleport_region, and des.levregion, through lspo_terrain, l_selection_check, lspo_replace_terrain, lspo_teleport_region, l_get_lregion, and levregion_add, with fixup_special placing the stored regions in finish().
